sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py: a dark violet robe with gold trim; hide is MU's black cap over the openings. lower_14m_t is the .OZT lower_14m, opaque, the framed front panel on its 56 triangles; the rest wear the .OZJ.
material_note: cloth: the Grand Soul is a robe, dark violet with gold trim painted on, not plate.
sheets_note: By group, as the bake matches: MU's .bmd names the texture and the obj group follows it, so a sheet renamed on disk (a jpg and a tga of one stem; an .OZT kept apart) has to be told which group it paints, or that group bakes black (2026-10-04: the user, 'texture is broken').
